dialogue.speaker: Mira Dalvane
dialogue.text: Three patrols vanished near the northern pass. Your village is the last place anyone saw them alive.

dialogue.speaker: Tobren Ashfield
dialogue.text: Alive is a big word, girl. Sit, have some tea. My grandmother used to say a closed mouth catches no storms.

dialogue.speaker: Mira Dalvane
dialogue.text: I am not here for tea. The lights over the pass started after the thaw. You have lived here fifty years. What are they?

dialogue.speaker: Tobren Ashfield
dialogue.text: Lights? Old men see lights. Old men also see their youth in the fire. I would not trust either.

dialogue.speaker: Mira Dalvane
dialogue.text: Your hands are shaking, Elder. I will ask once more, and then I will report this village to the crown.

dialogue.speaker: Tobren Ashfield
dialogue.text: Report what? That a few farmers keep to themselves? Go home, scout. Some roads should stay closed.
